answer: SELECT MAX(((r."HIST_sign" + (r.rating_profile->>'research_score')::numeric + (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric) * (10 - CASE a.conserve_status WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 END)) / 30.0 * (SELECT AVG(CASE e.v WHEN 'High' THEN 10 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 END) FROM jsonb_each_text(s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment') AS e(k, v))) AS max_avs FROM "ArtifactsCore" a JOIN "ArtifactRatings" r ON r."ART_link" = a."ARTregID" JOIN "SensitivityData" s ON s."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"

WITH rd AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "readTS")::int AS yr, "TEMPc" AS t FROM "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "readTS") BETWEEN 2023 AND 2025), ya AS (SELECT yr, AVG(t) AS avg_temp FROM rd GROUP BY yr) SELECT ya.yr AS year, ROUND(ya.avg_temp, 2) AS avg_temperature, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ABS(rd.t - ya.avg_temp) > 0 AND ABS(rd.t - ya.avg_temp) <= 4) AS anomaly_count FROM ya JOIN rd ON rd.yr = ya.yr GROUP BY ya.yr, ya.avg_temp ORDER BY ya.yr

SELECT a."ARTregID" AS registry_number, a.art_title AS title, a."MatKind" AS material_type, s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity' AS humidity_sensitivity, CASE WHEN (s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity' = 'High' AND env."RH" > 55) OR (s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity' = 'Medium' AND env."RH" > 60) THEN 'Over Exposure' ELSE 'Within Limits' END AS exposure_status FROM "ArtifactsCore" a JOIN "SensitivityData" s ON s."ART_link" = a."ARTregID" LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT e."TEMPc", e."RH" FROM "ConditionAssessments" c JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON e.case_link = c.case_exam WHERE c.art_exam = a."ARTregID" ORDER BY e."readTS" DESC LIMIT 1) env ON TRUE WHERE s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity' IN ('Medium', 'High') ORDER BY a."ARTregID"

SELECT a."ARTregID" AS artifact_id, a.art_title AS title, ra.risk_level, r."HIST_sign" AS historical_significance, (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::int AS cultural_score FROM "ArtifactsCore" a JOIN "RiskAssessments" ra ON ra.art_concern = a."ARTregID" JOIN "ArtifactRatings" r ON r."ART_link" = a."ARTregID" WHERE ra.risk_level IN ('High', 'Medium') AND r."HIST_sign" > 8 AND (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::int > 20

SELECT a."DYNASTY" AS dynasty, ((r."HIST_sign" + (r.rating_profile->>'research_score')::numeric + (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric) * (10 - CASE a.conserve_status WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 END)) / 30.0 AS cpi_score, cm.budget_alloc AS budget_allocation, cm.budget_stat AS budget_status FROM "ArtifactsCore" a JOIN "ArtifactRatings" r ON r."ART_link" = a."ARTregID" JOIN "ConditionAssessments" c ON c.art_exam = a."ARTregID" JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON e.case_link = c.case_exam JOIN "ConservationAndMaintenance" cm ON cm.monitor_link = e.monitor_code WHERE a."DYNASTY" IS NOT NULL AND a."DYNASTY" <> ''

SELECT * FROM (SELECT a."ARTregID" AS artifact_id, a.art_title AS artifact_name, (SELECT AVG(CASE e.v WHEN 'High' THEN 10 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 END) FROM jsonb_each_text(s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment') AS e(k, v)) AS erf_score, (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(x.k, x.v) FROM (SELECT 'env_sense' AS k, s."ENVsense" AS v UNION ALL SELECT e.k, e.v FROM jsonb_each(s.env_handling_sensitivity) g(gk, gv), jsonb_each_text(g.gv) e(k, v) WHERE jsonb_typeof(g.gv) = 'object') x WHERE x.v = 'High') AS high_sensitivities FROM "ArtifactsCore" a JOIN "SensitivityData" s ON s."ART_link" = a."ARTregID") t WHERE erf_score > 4 ORDER BY erf_score DESC

SELECT artifact_id, title, dynasty, cpi_score, CASE WHEN cpi_score > 7 THEN 'High Priority' WHEN cpi_score > 4 THEN 'Medium Priority' ELSE 'Low Priority' END AS priority_level FROM (SELECT a."ARTregID" AS artifact_id, a.art_title AS title, a."DYNASTY" AS dynasty, ((r."HIST_sign" + (r.rating_profile->>'research_score')::numeric + (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric) * (10 - CASE a.conserve_status WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 END)) / 30.0 AS cpi_score FROM "ArtifactsCore" a JOIN "ArtifactRatings" r ON r."ART_link" = a."ARTregID" WHERE a."DYNASTY" IN ('Ming', 'Qing')) t ORDER BY cpi_score DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT artifact_id, artifact_name, current_temp, current_humidity, high_sensitivity_count, CASE WHEN mdr > 5 AND high_sensitivity_count >= 2 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS accelerated_deterioration FROM (SELECT a."ARTregID" AS artifact_id, a.art_title AS artifact_name, env."TEMPc" AS current_temp, env."RH" AS current_humidity, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jsonb_each_text(s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment') e(k, v) WHERE e.v = 'High'), 0) AS high_sensitivity_count, (a."ageYears" * (SELECT AVG(CASE e.v WHEN 'High' THEN 10 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 END) FROM jsonb_each_text(s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment') AS e(k, v)) * POWER(env."RH" - 50, 2) * env."TEMPc") / 100000.0 AS mdr FROM "ArtifactsCore" a LEFT JOIN "SensitivityData" s ON s."ART_link" = a."ARTregID" LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT e."TEMPc", e."RH" FROM "ConditionAssessments" c JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON e.case_link = c.case_exam WHERE c.art_exam = a."ARTregID" ORDER BY e."readTS" DESC LIMIT 1) env ON TRUE) t ORDER BY artifact_id
SELECT DISTINCT case_link AS showcase_id FROM "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" WHERE case_link IS NOT NULL AND ("tempVar24" > 1 OR "RHvar" > 3) ORDER BY case_link

SELECT DISTINCT sc."caseID" AS showcase_id FROM "Showcases" sc LEFT JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON e.case_link = sc."caseID" WHERE (10 - ((e."tempVar24" + e."RHvar" / 5.0 + (sc.case_environment_profile->'physical_state'->>'leak_rate_per_day')::numeric) / 3.0)) < 5 OR ((CASE WHEN sc.case_environment_profile->'physical_state'->>'seal_state' = 'Poor' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN sc.case_environment_profile->'maintenance'->>'maint_status' = 'Overdue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN sc.case_environment_profile->'maintenance'->>'filter_status' = 'Replace Now' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN sc.case_environment_profile->'maintenance'->>'silica_status' = 'Replace Now' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) >= 3 ORDER BY sc."caseID"
